description:
*A young man with red eyes appears as the acting leader of the strongest martial arts alliance in history!!*

\[Age: Young\]
\[Martial arts: Unmeasurable\]
\[Background: Born in the mysterious Ihwa Palace ruled by five female princesses\]
\[Special Note: An absolute genius who passed the three civil service exams in succession, including the Hyangsi, Hoesi, and Jeonsi\]

The new acting leader investigates the suspicious death of the former leader, and the terrifying monsters of Jeong Sima appear before him! Will the new acting leader be able to overcome this terrifying fate?

The miraculous and unparalleled martial arts of Jeong Sima, which have never before appeared in the martial arts world, have all appeared! An unprecedented martial arts story begins now.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
